meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可为 NanoClaw 新增 DeltaChat 通道:复制注册适配器、安装依赖、配置邮箱参数,并把私聊或群聊关联到智能体。消息走加密邮件,支持附件和换头像。
howto.when: 当你提出要给 NanoClaw 接入 DeltaChat 时触发,首次配置和给运行中的实例补通道都适用。邮箱的 6 项必需参数不全会报凭据缺失并停住。

say.text: 帮我把这个机器人接上 DeltaChat。
say.note: 会按步骤接入,缺邮箱凭据会先提醒。

say.text: 给我生成 DeltaChat 邀请链接和二维码。
say.note: 会从日志取链接,并给出二维码文件位置。

say.text: 把 DeltaChat 这条私聊接到现有智能体上。
say.note: 会查询会话 ID 并完成接线。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude add a DeltaChat channel to a NanoClaw project: copy/register the adapter, install its package, set mailbox variables, and wire chats to agents. Messages travel over encrypted email; attachments are supported.
howto.when_en: Use when DeltaChat should be added to NanoClaw, during initial setup or on an existing instance. All six mailbox variables must be present, otherwise startup reports missing credentials.

say_en.text: Please connect this bot to DeltaChat.
say_en.note: Runs the integration steps and checks mailbox credentials.

say_en.text: Give me the DeltaChat invite link and QR code.
say_en.note: Reads the invite URL from logs and gives the QR file path.

say_en.text: Wire this DeltaChat DM to the current agent.
say_en.note: Looks up the chat ID and completes the wiring.
